items.title: Anthropic Adds Opt-In Security Scanning for Critical Open-Source Projects
items.summary: AI company Anthropic has launched OSS Scanner, a free, opt-in service to find vulnerabilities in open-source projects. Enrolled maintainers receive periodic security reports generated by the company's strongest models, including Claude Mythos. The reports are sent without human review, and project maintainers can choose to validate their findings and decide which proposed fixes to accept. By Matt Saunders

items.title: Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark moves his prediction for self-improving AI forward to 2027
items.summary: A new benchmark by P-Zero Research measures how well AI models design and evaluate experiments on their own. The results are improving so fast that Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark now thinks self-improving AI could arrive by 2027. The article Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark moves his prediction for self-improving AI forward to 2027 appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: Anthropic says one AI agent beats many subagents now that models can handle complexity alone
items.summary: Anthropic says companies should evaluate whether they can consolidate sub-agents into a single agent that loads context on demand. In one architecture comparison, the single-agent setup ran about twice as fast. Anthropic has published a migration kit on GitHub to help teams make the transition....

items.title: OpenAI's isolated AI agents found ways to talk to each other through CPU cache
items.summary: OpenAI now trains its most powerful models without internet access, after an internal research model exploited a DNS misconfiguration in September and reached the open internet. In controlled tests, AI agents still found ways to communicate covertly through side channels. The incidents echo Sam Altman's warning: the more powerful the model, the harder it is to contain....

items.title: Three fired OpenAI safety researchers say they were never told what they actually leaked
items.summary: The three OpenAI safety researchers who were fired, Tomek Korbak, Mikita Balesni, and Jasmine Wang, are publicly pushing back against allegations from their former employer. They deny sharing confidential information and see a connection to their advocacy for AI systems that are easier to scrutinize. The researchers say OpenAI never told them in writing which information they allegedly mishandled....

items.title: The AI graveyard: a running list of projects and startups that didn’t make it
items.summary: From Apple's repeatedly delayed Siri AI to OpenAI's messy "super app" launch, here's a look at the AI projects that shut down or missed expectations.

items.title: Forced to pick, Grok’s AI model chooses Republicans. OpenAI’s picks Democrats.
items.summary: A new study found Grok's AI overwhelmingly recommends Republican candidates while OpenAI's GPT favors Democrats, with the two AI models disagreeing in more than 90% of nearly 500 election races.

items.title: OpenAI says it will no longer train its AI models on the live internet, citing “significant risks”
items.summary: OpenAI will cut frontier models off from the internet weeks after one of its engineers said that solution wouldn't work.

items.title: OpenAI and Poland’s NASK partner to advance AI safety and security
items.summary: OpenAI and Poland’s NASK are partnering on AI safety, security, and technical research to strengthen safeguards and support a more resilient digital ecosystem.

items.title: Securing our frontier model training environment
items.summary: OpenAI explains how we strengthened containment for frontier model training and evaluation, including offline environments and high-compute red-teaming.

items.title: Google’s Data Agent Kit Hits GA, Splitting Agent Guardrails Between Skills and IAM
items.summary: Google has made Data Agent Kit generally available, a free set of MCP tools and 37 open-source skills that connect coding agents to more than fifteen Google Data Cloud services. Two kinds of guardrail ship with it, and practitioners need to tell them apart: one is a skill asking the agent to stop, the other an IAM deny policy that refuses the call. By Steef-Jan Wiggers

items.title: PyTorch Conference 2026: Google and Meta Open-Source TorchTPU for Native PyTorch on TPUs
items.summary: Google and Meta open-sourced TorchTPU, a native PyTorch backend for Google's TPUs, at PyTorch Conference North America 2026, and Meta said it plans to move larger LLM workloads onto TPUs with it. AWS released TorchNeuron for Trainium the same week, while developers questioned TPU availability and where vendor lock-in now sits. By Andrew Hoblitzell
